jobs.title: BA/Technical Product Manager
jobs.description: Headquarters: United States URL: https://jobs.workable.com/company/u8TybTAE2YbYgRVFYov9t4/jobs-at-proarch Partner Discovery & Requirements Analysis Lead and document working sessions with clinical, finance, operations, product, and technical stakeholders to understand existing workflows, business rules, data requirements, and operational processes. Translate manual and system-supported workflows into structured business and functional requirements. Produce gap-analysis documentation mapping current-state processes and partner requirements to existing platform capabilities. Classify requirements based on appropriate disposition, such as existing functionality, configuration, new development, acceptable operational workaround, shared platform enhancement, or out of scope. Maintain a consistent backlog structure across implementations so requirements remain comparable, traceable, and reusable. System Reconciliation & Technical Analysis Analyze application logic, SQL, stored procedures, configuration parameters, integrations, and data flows to understand existing system behavior. Determine whether business requirements can be satisfied through configuration, existing functionality, process changes, or new development. Validate assumptions about platform behavior against available technical evidence and distinguish confirmed system behavior from inferred behavior. Identify discrepancies between documented behavior, stakeholder expectations, system configuration, and implemented logic. Trace business rules to underlying parameters, data elements, calculations, integrations, and system components. Identify where behaviors are configurable versus hardcoded and assess the impact on future implementations. Requirements Authoring Write clear business and functional requirements, user stories, acceptance criteria, assumptions, dependencies, open questions, and proposed workarounds. Maintain appropriate separation between business-facing requirements and technical implementation details. Ensure acceptance criteria reflect the agreed solution approach, including configuration changes, operational workarounds, or new functionality. Apply a consistent standard for distinguishing standalone requirements from assumptions, configuration decisions, implementation details, or operational procedures. Maintain traceability from business need through solution decision and development implementation. Cross-Functional Facilitation & Governance Facilitate requirements, solutioning, and review sessions across business, clinical, product, engineering, data, and operational teams. Drive open questions toward resolution and update requirements and documentation to reflect confirmed decisions. Identify ambiguity, conflicting requirements, downstream impacts, and cross-feature dependencies before development begins. Prevent scope drift and ensure implementation-specific requirements do not unintentionally become platform-wide requirements. Support prioritization and decision-making by clearly communicating business impact, implementation complexity, dependencies, and risk. Ticket Creation & Scoping Translate approved requirements into development-ready tickets containing problem statements, user stories, functional scope, acceptance criteria, dependencies, assumptions, and open questions. Partner with engineering and architecture teams to clarify technical scope and implementation approach. Track dependencies across features, integrations, implementations, and shared platform capabilities. Identify common capabilities that can support multiple clients, workflows, or future implementations rather than creating one-off solutions. 8+ years of experience as a Business Analyst, Technical Product Manager, Product Owner, or equivalent role in a software-, data-, or technology-driven environment. Experience working within healthcare technology, healthcare operations, payer/provider systems, pharmacy, claims, revenue cycle, eligibility, or related healthcare domains.

jobs.description: About the role You'll join Beacon's Portfolio Product team — a cross-functional group of Product Managers, Engineers, Designers, GTM experts, and Data Scientists working directly with our 40+ portfolio companies and counting (at roughly one new acquisition per week) to drive measurable outcomes through AI and software. At the core, every PM at Beacon owns product outcomes for 2 to 5 portfolio companies at a time, acting as a hands-on, founding product leader embedded in each business. You'll sit close to the GM, the operators, and the customers, figure out where the leverage is, and ship software directly into the business. The best PMs don't just deliver for the companies they're deployed at — they compress what they learn into reusable playbooks that spread to every other portfolio company in the same vertical. The ultimate objective is to transform our portfolio companies into unicorns! For the right candidates, this role grows beyond individual ownership. As your vertical scales, you may build and lead a team of PMs, take on hiring and coaching responsibilities, and become the person who sets product vision and standards across an entire industry segment — partnering directly with GMs, founders & operators, and driving planning across the whole portfolio. How much of that path applies to you depends on your background and trajectory, and we'll shape the role around what you bring. This is not a consulting role. We ship software, not slides. The deliverable is a running system. Key Responsibilities • Own product outcomes for 2 to 5 portfolio companies simultaneously, acting as a fractional/founding product leader embedded in each business • Lead quarterly and annual planning, helping teams set product visions and translate them into achievable goals • Build and maintain roadmaps that balance customer needs, business goals, and technical constraints • Drive sprint planning and execution, improving team velocity and predictability over time • Develop prioritization frameworks that help CEOs and operators make better product decisions • Build customer feedback systems that turn qualitative inputs into actionable roadmap decisions • Coordinate feature launches across engineering, sales, marketing, and support • Coach developers, designers, and early PMs to think like product managers • Distill learnings into cross-portfolio playbooks that scale impact beyond your assigned companies • Partner with GMs, founders, and operators to set product vision and translate it into executable roadmaps • Contribute to Beacon's broader AI platform by surfacing patterns and opportunities from your companies As your scope grows you may also • Build and lead a team of PMs, hiring, onboarding, and developing them as your portfolio scales • Codify cross-portfolio playbooks that turn individual wins into repeatable systems across an entire vertical • Set the bar for how great product work looks at Beacon — spec quality, customer discovery, prioritization rigor • Own product strategy and outcomes across a defined vertical, not just individual companies What We're Looking For • BA/BS degree; MBA a plus • 4+ years of product management experience, ideally in B2B SaaS (senior candidates typically bring 7+ years, including 2+ years in a formal leadership role or as a co-founder) • Strong fundamentals: roadmapping, sprint planning, spec writing, prioritization frameworks • Sharp customer discovery instincts and the ability to identify high-impact opportunities fast • Comfortable managing multiple companies and stakeholders simultaneously • Ability to influence founders and executives without direct authority • For more senior candidates: a proven track record leading and developing other PMs, not just doing great PM work individually • Strong systems thinking — you see patterns across companies and know how to turn them into playbooks • High autonomy, low ego.
